description.value: Thomas Haas Chocolates is a celebrated Vancouver-area patisserie and chocolatier with two café locations, known for handcrafted chocolates, French macarons, cakes, and gourmet sandwiches made by an in-house team of pastry chefs. The North Shore location sits at Harbourside Drive near the North Vancouver waterfront, making it a natural refuelling stop on the popular seaside cycling routes of the area. The shop also carries a 'Powered by Chocolate' cycling jersey line, signalling a deliberate nod to cycling culture.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Contact Us page confirms the North Shore Store address (128-998 Harbourside Drive, North Vancouver, V7P 3T2) and phone (604-924-1847), both matching OSM. The site describes the cafe as serving 'gourmet sandwiches, pastries and sweet treats' and lists pickup/delivery ordering, confirming takeout is available. No website content mentions bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities; OSM has outdoor_seating=yes but no bike-related tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: This OSM record covers only the North Shore (Harbourside) location. A second location exists at 2539 West Broadway, Vancouver (604-736-1848) and may be a separate OSM record requiring its own listing.
OSM address omits the unit number (128); the website lists it as 128-998 Harbourside Drive.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-known artisan café and chocolatier on the North Shore waterfront — a strong destination stop for touring cyclists, reinforced by the brand's own cycling jersey product line.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 'Powered by Chocolate' cycling jersey sold on the website suggests the brand actively courts the cycling community and may be receptive to WWC partnership outreach.

wow_evidence: 'Powered by Chocolate' cycling jersey line, signalling a deliberate nod to cycling culture
